name: Kenya
summary: East African economic hub with Great Rift Valley geothermal reservoirs and Lake Turkana wind fields. World leader in clean power transition with nearly 90% renewable electricity generation.

pm25.name: Annual Mean PM2.5 Exposure
pm25.source_dataset: State of Global Air (SOGA) 2024 / Global Burden of Disease
pm25.context: 4.76x the WHO 2021 annual guideline (5 µg/m³); Nairobi traffic congestion and rural biomass cooking smoke drive exposure.

temp_anomaly.name: Surface Temperature Anomaly
temp_anomaly.context: Relative to 1951-1980 baseline; recurrent multi-season drought severely impacts northern pastoral counties.

temp_trend.name: 30-Year Warming Trend Rate
temp_trend.context: Linear least-squares warming trend across Rift Valley and coastal stations over 1994-2023.

co2_total.name: Total Territorial Fossil CO2
co2_total.context: 0.06% share of global fossil emissions; transport fuels account for over two-thirds of fossil emissions.

co2_per_capita.name: Per Capita Fossil CO2
co2_per_capita.context: Extremely low per capita emissions; geothermal and hydro dominance minimizes grid emissions.

forest_share.name: Forest Cover Fraction
forest_share.source_dataset: Global Forest Resources Assessment via World Bank (AG.LND.FRST.ZS)
forest_share.context: Montane water towers (Mount Kenya, Aberdares, Mau Forest) covering ~36,000 km²; national target is 10%.

renewables_share.name: Renewable Share of Electricity
renewables_share.context: Global clean grid standout: Olkaria geothermal fields provided 47.2%, hydro 25.1%, and Lake Turkana wind 16.4%.

population.name: Total Population & Density
population.context: Arithmetic population density of 97 people/km²; urban population fraction is 29.0%.
